attacks.claim: The new duplicate-ballot log line writes the voter's email together with the measure and their choice. This links a resident's identity to their ballot in application logs. Those logs ship to a third-party host readable by the whole support team, which breaks the anonymity promise and cannot be undone once shipped.
attacks.evidence: logger.info("duplicate ballot rejected measure=%s voter=%s choice=%s", measure_id, user.email, body.choice.value,)
